p: cloths of service: As coverings for the ark, the candlestick, the altars and such like.
signets are graven: That is, of very fine and curious workmanship.
a ligure: Or, a turkeis, a stone which the authors write comes from the urine of the Lynx.
according to their names: That is, every tribe had his name written on a stone.
ephod of woven work: Which was next under the Ephod.
there was an hole in the: Where he could put his head through.
vail of the covering: So called, because it hung before the mercyseat and covered it from sight Ex 35:12.
set in order: Or, which Aaron dressed and refreshed with oil every morning Ex 30:7.
commanded Moses: Signifying that in God's matters man may neither add, nor diminish.
blessed them: Praised God for the peoples diligence and prayed for them.
